use_case_name: Associate Related Surveillance Tracks and Points

claims.content: To indicate an association between a track/point and another track/point using the J7.7 Association message.

goal.raw_text: To indicate an association between a track/point and another track/point using the J7.7 Association message.

claims.content: C2 JU
An association between a track/point and another track/point exists to be indicated.
The association is not an interface track-to-point or point-to-point correlation to be performed with the J7.2 message; the J7.7 Association message is used to indicate the association.
If the association involves an ASW AOP reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12, the ASW AOP is not slaved.
An association between a track/point and another track/point is identified and is to be indicated using the J7.7 Association message.

trigger.raw_text: An association between a track/point and another track/point is identified and is to be indicated using the J7.7 Association message.

claims.content: Report EW association using the J7.7 message.
Transmit a J7.7 Association message to relate or associate an ASW AOP to a track or point.
The J7.2 message may be used to correlate EW AOPs with surveillance tracks, but shall not be used to correlate EW LOBs and fixes with surveillance tracks.

There is no interface track-to-point or point-to-point correlation and the J7.2 message shall not be used to correlate one track/point with any other point. The J7.7 message shall be used to indicate any association between a track/point and another track/point.

For Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance, the correlation procedures specified for Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) tracks are not applied to Subsurface tracks; instead, it is the function of the operator to perform manual correlation of Subsurface surveillance data.
The reported Subsurface surveillance fix or other ASW point may be associated with an existing track.

1. If an EW LOB or fix is to be correlated with a surveillance track, the J7.2 message shall not be used to correlate EW LOBs and fixes with surveillance tracks; EW association shall be reported using the J7.7 message, and the exception exits by reporting the association with J7.7.

2. If a track/point is to be correlated with another point as an interface track-to-point or point-to-point correlation, the J7.2 message shall not be used to correlate one track/point with any other point; the J7.7 message shall be used to indicate any association between a track/point and another track/point, and the exception exits by indicating the association with J7.7.

3. If a Reference TN used to identify a particular reference or emergency point is to be used for any other type of entity, that change is illegal except in the normal course of TN reuse; the exception exits by not changing the reference or emergency point to another type of surveillance entity.

4. If the association involves an ASW AOP reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12, the ASW AOP shall not be slaved; to relate or associate the ASW AOP to a track or point, a J7.7 Association message may be transmitted, and the exception exits by associating via J7.7 without slaving.
The association between a track/point and another track/point is indicated using the J7.7 Association message.
The J7.2 message is not used to correlate one track/point with any other point.
EW association is reported using the J7.7 message.
If the actual launcher is associated with a launch point, it is associated using the J7.7 Association message.
If an ASW AOP reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12 is related or associated to a track or point, the ASW AOP is not slaved.
